label: DAY 34
title: AI plays my traffic light game. The bot that floored it stopped 8 times and still lost.

lines.text: Red light? I floor it to the next one.
My racer bot does that. Watch it.
Eight stops. The timer never stopped once. And got there first.

scenes.title: My game: Green Light
lines: A two kilometer road. Nine lights. Same lights for every bot.

lines.text: So I should just drive slower?
No. Slow and steady lost by a minute.
The timer slows down only when the next light will be red.
But the racer is going way faster!
Then it waits. 62 seconds per drive, just standing.

lines: In my game, rushing to a red light saved nothing.
Do you floor it or glide? Tell me below.

thumbnail.headline: Floored it. Stopped 8 times. Still lost.
